subject: Leveling criteria: routing L5 vs L6 (IC vs Manager) for Alexei Novak
messages:

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Leveling calibration for candidate Alexei Novak (REQ-1423)

Hi Laura & Karthik —

Quick sync request: Alexei Novak (external recruiter: BldgTalent) has completed interviews for the ML infra role on REQ-1423. Hiring manager prefers L6 title, but the interview feedback is mixed on scope: strong system design + leadership in prior startups, but no direct reports in last 5 years. Manager vs IC will materially change comp and approval path.

Can you weigh in on:
- whether we should anchor at L5 (senior IC) vs L6 (senior manager) given scope and candidate history
- what documentation/commitments we would need to route to the hiring committee if we go L6
- any immediate red flags on comp or headcount that would block an L6 offer

I attached the candidate resume. I can pull together the interview summary if that helps. Need to decide before Friday so TA can draft an offer.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

Attachments: alexei_novak_resume.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Leveling calibration for candidate Alexei Novak (REQ-1423)

Monica —

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed the loop notes (summary below) and my take:

Summary of interviews:
- Technical loop: excellent ML infra intuition, strong latency/cost tradeoffs, designed scalable KV layer at previous company.
- Execution: delivered shipped systems but mostly as an IC contributor; led cross-team projects, not direct people management.
- Behavioral: demonstrates mentorship, runs postmortems, but no documented headcount ownership.

Recommendation: Anchor at L5 (Senior IC) for the offer. Rationale: L6 at Redwood typically requires 1) clear history of people management or being the primary lead for multi-team initiatives with strategic ownership, or 2) a documented org-level impact case. Alexei shows the latter partially but lacks sustained people management evidence.

If the hiring manager wants L6, we should ask them to articulate the scope change (direct reports, P&L, or strategic program ownership) and provide a one-pager for the hiring committee. That will trigger comp exception review and headcount reclassification.

Happy to discuss quickly.

- Laura
VP, Engineering (Hiring Partner)

Subject: Re: Leveling calibration for candidate Alexei Novak (REQ-1423)

Monica/Laura —

Agree with Laura's read. A couple of comp/headcount notes from my side:

1) Comp bands: L5 midpoint for this market band (SF, late-2027) is $210k base + target equity 0.25%–0.45% + standard bonus. L6 moves base mid to ~$280k and equity to ~0.6%+. That's a substantial delta and will affect budget and payroll forecasting.

2) Headcount approval: REQ-1423 is currently approved as "IC Senior Engineer" in Workday. To proceed as L6 Manager we need a headcount change request reclassifying the role and GC approval. That will take ~7–10 business days unless we flag it as time-sensitive.

3) Alternative: offer at L5 with a clear growth plan and manager-track rubric. Include a 6–9 month checkpoint tied to measurable delivery and people-lead indicators. If that hits, we can do an in-cycle promotion and backfill any comp delta with a one-time hiring premium. This preserves speed to hire.

If the hiring manager is insistent on L6 now, we should get a written business justification (org chart, scope, direct reports expected, KPI ownership) and loop in Finance for comp exceptions.

-Karthik
Head of Talent Operations

Subject: Re: Leveling calibration for candidate Alexei Novak (REQ-1423) — comp + approval details

Folks —

Adding comp ops perspective. Attached is the current comp band reference for L5/L6 in comp_band_L5-L6.xlsx and a draft offer template for L5. Key points:

- If we extend L6 without headcount reclassification we create an audit gap in Workday—Finance will push back. We can temporarily use a discretionary spot bonus but that is not a substitute for proper leveling.
- Equity refresh cadence: candidate's target equity should be set against role level; offering L6 equity on an L5 headcount triggers comp escalations in our systems.
- Approvals: For L6 we need GC sign-off + VP-level approval and Finance sign-off for comp exceptions > 15% of band mid.

Given timeline constraints, my operational recommendation matches Karthik's: extend L5 with a manager-track addendum (6-month review + documented career plan). If the manager provides the org justification within the next two weeks we can fast-track reclassification but not in time to close this week.

-Tessa
Director, Total Rewards

Attachments: comp_band_L5-L6.xlsx, offer_template_L5.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: BldgTalent <talent@bldgtalent.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final decision: extend L5 (senior IC) with manager-track language — Alexei Novak (REQ-1423)

Thanks all for the quick input. Based on the interview evidence and the comp/headcount constraints, we will:

1) Extend an L5 (Senior IC) offer today. Use the attached L5 offer template.
2) Include a manager-track addendum: 6-month checkpoint with objective criteria (lead cross-team project, mentor two engineers, measurable delivery metric). If the candidate meets criteria, we will run an in-cycle level re-evaluation and recommend promotion to L6 with pro-rated comp catch-up.
3) Ask the hiring manager to produce the short one-pager org justification for L6 if they still prefer that route — we will submit it to GC + Finance, but expect a 7–10 business day SLA for reclassification.

Monica — please loop me if the candidate pushes back on level or requests faster reclassification; we'll triage with Finance. Monica to TA: attach offer_template_L5.pdf and copy in BldgTalent so they can confirm candidate details.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

Cc: BldgTalent — please share candidate availability for a call after offer is sent.
